methodologyNotes: Pricing re-verified via WebFetch on each vendor's official pricing page (readme.com/pricing, stoplight.io/pricing, redocly.com/pricing, bump.sh/pricing, theneo.io/pricing, mintlify.com/pricing, gitbook.com/pricing, scalar.com/pricing) on 2026-06-15. Apidog (apidog.com/pricing) and Document360 (document360.com/pricing) render pricing client-side and returned no extractable price data; Apidog plan prices corroborated via plans.apis.io and g2/trustradius; Document360 confirmed quote-only since late 2024 via g2, checkthat.ai, and happysupport.ai (all monthlyUsd left null — no number invented). Compliance re-checked on official security/trust pages: theneo.io/security explicitly lists SOC2+ISO27001+ISO9001+GDPR (completed, annual audits); redocly.com/security confirms SOC2 Type II + CSA STAR + GDPR DPA; bump.sh/security explicitly states NO SOC2/ISO27001 but maintains GDPR DPA; gitbook blog confirms SOC2 Type II + ISO27001; mintlify SOC2 confirmed (GDPR in progress→null); stoplight names no certifications publicly (all null); ReadMe SOC2 report + GDPR DPA confirmed, HIPAA on gated portal left null. All pages accessed 2026-06-15.
